2608.20320.title: An Agentic Approach for Active Data Collection, Travel Behavior Modeling, and Weather-Sensitive Demand Prediction
2608.20320.paper_summary: Travel behavior research increasingly combines digital data collection with predictive modeling, yet these stages are often developed and evaluated separately. This study proposes a three-agent workflow integrating conversational data collection, structured data processing, and behavioral prediction. A chatbot-administered, image-augmented stated-preference survey collected mode choices from student commuters across five predefined weather scenarios, yielding 454 respondent-scenario observations. Weather-related associations were analyzed using a multinomial logit model, while logistic regression and random forest provided machine-learning benchmarks. Nine locally deployed large language models (LLMs), ranging from 2 to 35 billion parameters, were evaluated across four zero-shot prompt-and-context conditions and extended through persona, few-shot, and vision-based configurations. Random forest achieved 69.6% five-class accuracy, while the best text-only zero-shot LLM reached 69.9% without task-specific fitting. Habitual travel information produced the most consistent gains, Expert framing generally outperformed Role-Play, and persona information was most useful when habitual travel information was unavailable. Few-shot prompting improved prediction for several models, with gains stabilizing after a small number of examples. Using the same weather images shown to respondents, the best vision-based configuration reached 71.5% five-class accuracy, indicating that visual context may provide additional predictive information for selected models. Overall, the study shows how conversational surveys, structured data processing, conventional behavioral modeling, machine learning, and multimodal LLM prediction can be coordinated within an auditable multi-agent workflow.
2608.20320.paper_summary_zh: 旅行行為研究越來越多地將數位數據收集與預測建模結合起來，但這些階段通常是分開開發和評估的。本研究提出了一個三代理工作流程，整合了對話數據收集、結構化數據處理和行為預測。一項由聊天機器人管理、圖像增強的陳述偏好調查收集了來自五個預定天氣情境的學生通勤者的模式選擇，共獲得454個受訪者-情境觀察。使用多項式邏輯模型分析了與天氣相關的關聯，而邏輯回歸和隨機森林則提供了機器學習基準。評估了九個本地部署的大型語言模型（LLMs），其參數範圍從20億到350億，並在四種零樣本提示和上下文條件下進行評估，並通過角色、少量樣本和基於視覺的配置進行擴展。隨機森林達到了69.6%的五類準確率，而最佳的純文本零樣本LLM在沒有特定任務擬合的情況下達到了69.9%。習慣性旅行信息產生了最一致的增益，專家框架通常優於角色扮演，而當習慣性旅行信息不可用時，角色信息最為有用。少量樣本提示改善了幾個模型的預測，增益在少量示例後穩定。使用同樣的天氣圖像展示給受訪者，最佳的基於視覺的配置達到了71.5%的五類準確率，這表明視覺上下文可能為選定的模型提供額外的預測信息。總體而言，這項研究展示了如何在可審計的多代理工作流程中協調對話調查、結構化數據處理、傳統行為建模、機器學習和多模態LLM預測。
